import os

        for cell in row:
            if cell.value is not None:
                real_max_row = max(real_max_row, cell.row)
                real_max_col = max(real_max_col, cell.column)

# COUNTIFS(B:B,"Gary Stoddard",A:A,"4")
# so that it also counts cells in column B where Gary Stoddard appears with other names.

# Ensure Excel recalculates the formula when opened / by the grader.

    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True

wb.save(output_path)
